summary: The cart service container has exited, causing widespread failures in the frontend and checkout services.
symptoms: Traffic drop on cart, currency, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping.
High error rates on checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy.
High p95 latency on frontend and frontend-proxy.

root_cause.description: The cart service container has exited, causing all dependent services (frontend, checkout) to fail when attempting to access it.

evidence.explanation: The cart service container is in an exited state with exit code 0, indicating it has stopped.

evidence.quote: "exception.message": "14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: Error: connect EHOSTUNREACH 172.22.0.23:7070. Resolution note: "
evidence.explanation: Frontend and checkout services are failing with "UNAVAILABLE" and "name resolver error" when trying to communicate with the cart service, confirming the cart service is down.
Trace shows checkout failing because it cannot reach the cart service.
evidence.quote: "status_message": "cart failure: failed to get user cart during checkout: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = name resolver error: produced zero addresses"

ruled_out: The cart service did not crash due to OOM (oom_killed: false).
The database and other services are running, though some are experiencing latency due to the cascading failures.

proposed_action.reason: The cart service is down, causing a cascading failure. Restarting the service is the standard recovery procedure for a service_down/crash_loop scenario.
proposed_action.expected_outcome: The cart service container should restart and become healthy, resolving the dependency failures in the frontend and checkout services.
